meta.day_index: day of year 1-365 (31 Dec of leap years folded onto day 365)

sea_ice_extent.title: Daily Antarctic sea-ice extent (concentration ≥ 15 %)
sea_ice_extent.source: EUMETSAT OSI SAF OSI-450-a CDR + OSI-430-a ICDR via Copernicus Marine (C1)
sea_ice_extent.note: Days with missing swaths are omitted. Before 1987 the SMMR record is every other day.

t2m.title: Daily Antarctic-mean 2 m air temperature (60–90° S, area-weighted)
t2m.note: Daily ERA5 on disk starts in 2014, so the reference envelope uses 2014–2025 (short baseline).

era5_msl.title: Daily Antarctic-mean sea-level pressure (60–90° S, area-weighted)
era5_msl.note: Daily ERA5 on disk for this variable starts in 2014, so the reference envelope uses 2014–2025 (short baseline). Includes sea-level-reduced values over the ice sheet.

era5_t850.title: Daily Antarctic-mean 850 hPa temperature (60–90° S, area-weighted)
era5_t850.note: Daily ERA5 on disk for this variable starts in 2018, so the reference envelope uses 2018–2025 (short baseline). Includes values extrapolated below the plateau surface.

era5_z500.title: Daily Antarctic-mean 500 hPa geopotential height (60–90° S, area-weighted)
era5_z500.note: Daily ERA5 on disk for this variable starts in 2018, so the reference envelope uses 2018–2025 (short baseline). Low values mean a deep polar vortex; high values mean ridging/blocking.

era5_wind10.title: Daily Antarctic-mean 10 m wind speed (60–90° S, area-weighted)
era5_wind10.note: Daily ERA5 on disk for this variable starts in 2018, so the reference envelope uses 2018–2025 (short baseline). Speed of the daily-mean vector at each cell, then averaged.
